newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Nuplex sees bonus issue enhancing share value.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Nuplex sees bonus issue enhancing share value.

text.p: Auckland-based Nuplex Industries Ltd said on Friday its shares should become more attractive as a result of its taxable bonus share issue.
In late October Nuplex announced a taxable issue of one ordinary share for every ordinary share on issue at November 15.

"The direct practical tax benefits of this issue will be enjoyed only by shareholders classed as share traders for tax purposes, but this class of shareholder represents over 65 percent of all shares on issue," chairman Fred Holland told Nuplex shareholders at the company's AGM.
"This increased value of the shares to the traders should increase the attraction of Nuplex shares -- thus increasing the value of all shareholders' holdings," he said.

"All things considered, this opportunity was taken to release what value is locked up in our imputation tax credit account to the benefit of shareholders, and confirms the directors' commitment to enhancing shareholder value whenever possible," Holland said.

Nuplex earlier said its first quarter profit was ahead of last year despite far from ideal trading conditions. Growth in its special waste business and Australian company generated the profit improvement.
Total resin volumes were ahead of the same period last year, and raw material pricing near the bottom of the cycle had helped maintain margins in an increasingly competitive market.

Nuplex said it expected to maintain a steady rate of profit growth for the full year, with new business opportunities and offshore growth compensating for any uncertainty hanging over the New Zealand market.
